title: A time you received good service in a shop
titleVi: Lần bạn được phục vụ tốt ở cửa hàng
prompt: Describe a time when you received good service in a shop/store
bullets: when you went to the shop
what service you received from the staff
and explain how you felt about the service

notes.label: Service

part2.question: Describe a time when you received good service in a shop/store

segments.v: I want to talk about a camera shop in the Old Quarter. I went there two months ago to look for a film camera for my best friend. The shop is small and the owner is an old man. He has repaired cameras for thirty years. He was very friendly and helpful. He spent one hour with me. He showed me many cameras and explained them clearly. He did not try to sell me the expensive one. He told me which camera was good for a beginner. He also checked my camera and fixed a small problem for free. I felt very happy and surprised because the service was very good. I will go back to that shop to buy the camera. I also told my friends about it.
